message.reasoning_content:
Visual check batch 1:

cover: title wraps "镜桥产品体验日方案" with 案 alone on second line — orphan character. That's a readability/hierarchy issue. Title too large causing single-character wrap. Improvement/blocker? It looks awkward — "方" then "案" on next line. Should flag as blocker for visual quality (标题断行成孤字). Yes flag.

goals: looks good, though big title heading overlaps? "活动目标 | 收集可观察的使用问题" — the 目标口径 box left area is empty large box; fine. Note the left panel big empty space? There's a large empty box area between left column bottom and footer — acceptable. The "9项" tile has bronze tint. Fine. One issue: the left column box with 唯一核心目标 has large empty space; acceptable. Also subtitle "活动目标 | ..." repeated in header top-left small text. Fine.

flow: 5 columns, text readable; cards have big empty space at bottom in cards 01/02; badges aligned unevenly. Acceptable. Card 03 text wraps "体验分 组 7 组". Minor.

resources: top three metric cards have huge empty right area, English labels like INVITATION large and low contrast — looks like empty space. Cards 01-04 have very large empty lower halves — density/emptiness issue: significant white space, content top-heavy. Flag as improvement for resources (卡片大量空白，信息密度不足).

Main blockers: cover orphan character wrap. Let's record visual batch 1 issues: cover title wrap blocker; resources emptiness improvement; flow minor.

Then batch 2 pages feedback, pending.

Wait — should I record assessment for batch1 now or after viewing batch2? Record now with evidence_id.
